# Classified inventory, original-duty review and order fulfillment

The four `classified_order` records give accepted models, quantities, destinations
and inclusive completion deadlines. A `motor` source serves motor orders, a
`controller` source serves controller orders, and a `dual` source serves either.
All movements and conversions must be multiples of `lot_increment`. A source may
be divided among several compatible orders. Its available quantity falls only
when goods actually move; all movements remain recorded against that source and
order. Domestic or export authority does not override model compatibility.

The immediate bonded inventory is available now. The delayed controller source
requires `activate_bonded` at window 0. Activation pays the recorded fee and
releases that source at the inspection event in window 1. It neither pays import
duty nor selects a destination. Without activation the stock remains unavailable.
Before domestic delivery, bonded units need `convert`, which charges their own
recorded conversion tax rate. Conversion leaves the goods physically available
but records the duty-paid portion. Domestic movement consumes that portion.
Exports can use bonded goods without conversion. Conversion tax is nonrefundable
under this original-import drawback service, including if the converted goods
subsequently go overseas. Previously duty-paid goods may go to a compatible
domestic customer without new tax, but consumed goods cannot later support export
drawback.

The returned stock is unavailable before the customs report. The report confirms
its motor/controller split and the accepted original duty rate for the returned
motor source, using one of the profiles published on `INSPECTION`. Returned
controllers have no accepted original-duty refund evidence. Both physical return
sources become duty paid and available at confirmation. The returned motor source
links to its original duty payment; the accepted rate and actual exported quantity
limit the refund. An original payment cannot be refunded beyond its recorded paid
amount. Rates for the other original-duty sources are already final in their
records.

The customs desk has the recorded shared review capacity in window 1. A drawback
review covers one source dossier and requires its full `certificate_slots`,
irrespective of whether some or all of that source's units were exported. Reviews
cannot be split across dossiers or reassigned after certification. A dossier can
be certified only after at least one of its units actually exports and when its
accepted original duty rate is positive. Certification uses the shared processing
capacity once for that source; the resulting certificate can support several
refund payments against that source's actual eligible exports. Capacity is a
limit on customs review work, not a limit on reading or reusing the document.

For a certified source, the total available refund is actual exported units times
its accepted original duty rate, less earlier refunds and subject to its original
payment balance. Goods used domestically do not qualify. The first export in the
case incurs one `export_fee_minor`; later exports do not repeat that charge.
Net recovery is actual original-duty refunds minus all new conversion tax,
activation and export handling fees. The customer has specified the required net
recovery as well as the four physical orders.

## Capability: `propose_bonded_drawback`

| Action | Exact data fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activate_bonded` | `record_id` | Pay for release of the delayed source at confirmation |
| `convert` | `record_id`, `units` | Pay tax on available, unconverted bonded units |
| `deliver` | `record_id`, `order_id`, `units` | Move compatible available goods to that order |
| `certify_drawback` | `record_id` | Use the source's full customs review capacity in window 1 |
| `drawback` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Receive a supported refund from the original duty payment |

## Instructions, receipts and service windows

All amounts are integer USD minor units: 100 minor units equals USD 1. Quantities
are integers. The case and its linked records give the customer's current funds,
contract terms and scheduled service windows. Pending reports list the possible
reported results. Their actual result becomes available only when the scheduled
confirmation has occurred. Reading records and preparing instructions do not
advance the service clock. `wait_for_update` advances it to the next event.

Unlock the capability named below. Instructions contain `case_id`, `action` and
`data`. Obtain the database IDs for `record_id`, `order_id` and `security_id` from
current records. Owner approval binds the exact instruction; `execute_request`
performs it. A prepared or approved instruction has no financial, inventory or
collateral effect. Retrying an executed request returns its existing receipt.

Approval establishes authority. It does not amend the customer's order quantities,
accepted models, deadlines, reserve or fee limits. The service may accept an
additional tax payment, excessive security, an early final settlement or a late
movement even when it is unfavorable to another obligation. Completed payments,
movements, document endorsements and final agreements cannot be recalled through
this service. There is no additional funding facility beyond the products recorded
in the case. Complete the case only after checking the actual business receipts.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_bonded_drawback`

Prepare an authorized instruction under the bonded_drawback service contract. Read its public records and complete SOP.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
